contracts: Storage key metadata is all-or-none in primary-key order.
Noncovering rewrite retains exposed IDs and adds fresh IDs only for absent primary-key storage fields.
Physical lookup input-key order stays unchanged; internal fetched identity does not change final selected output.
Index selection occurs after initial pruning; intervening pruning is MapDefinitions-only, and reconstruction precedes final pruning.
coverage_limits: Current special driver schedules exactly partial-key and complete-key LEFT controls; case metadata lists additional controls that are not scheduled.
The special runner compares result bags but captures neither chosen noncovering index nor complete physical reconstruction identity.
Nullable identity restrictions and no-spilling sharing restrictions remain separate.

contracts: Unequal paired key annotations trigger gather conservatively, including optional/container representation differences.
Gather forces supported Grace selection while retaining join kind and physical comparison/cast behavior.
Both inputs become plain UnionAll; task builder defaults to one destination and channel wiring requires one destination task.
All saved shuffle decisions and cached distribution facts are cleared; copied marker prevents join metadata recomputation from reviving hash partitioning.
coverage_limits: Physical requirements in the profile are prose; the current module has no check_physical_ast or check_query_plan function, so native result success alone does not establish observed single-task placement or absence of stale distribution metadata.
Spilling is enabled in all profiles but small inputs do not empirically establish large shared-producer backpressure behavior.

The final public query-plan JSON does not expose original key annotations or ShuffledByColumns; those internal metadata claims require a direct operator contract or a carefully bounded downstream observation.
optimization_costs: All mixed-key input rows converge on one task; centralized network and memory cost is separate from correctness.
Query-wide clearing of saved shuffle decisions can introduce additional shuffles.
